summary: Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Company, a non-traded Delaware BDC, filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered private placement under Item 3.02: on September 1, 2026 it issued 910.51 common shares for aggregate proceeds of $9,325, with the share count determined September 22, 2026, sold via subscription agreements under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S. Item 8.01 separately discloses net asset value per share of $10.24 as of August 31, 2026. The micro-scale issuance and NAV disclosure are routine capital-continuity events, not a special situation. Terms imply roughly $10.24 per share pricing, consistent with NAV, with no board recommendation, advisor, or deal clock.
